name: EXAONE Path 2.0
task: Pathology Foundation Model and Feature Extraction
description: EXAONE Path 2.0, a pathology foundation model that learns patch-level representations under direct slide-level supervision. Using only 37k WSIs for training, EXAONE Path 2.0 achieves state-of-the-art average performance across 10 biomarker prediction tasks, demonstrating remarkable data efficiency.
data_source: Large-scale collection of pathology WSIs processed into patches
intended_use: Research and clinical support for pathology image analysis
references: PYEON, Myeongjang, et al. EXAONE Path 2.0: Pathology Foundation Model with End-to-End Supervision. arXiv preprint arXiv:2507.06639, 2025.
